# AFRO-TECH

> AFRO-TECH is a digital studio based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We design and
> build websites, ERP systems, POS platforms, and custom software for
> Ethiopian businesses — fast delivery, premium design, honest pricing.

## About the site

- [Home](https://afro-tech-et.vercel.app/): overview of the studio, showcase of
  systems we've built (ERP, POS, inventory, school, hotel/PMS, hospital,
  e-commerce), our process, testimonials, and the contact form.
- [Services & Pricing](https://afro-tech-et.vercel.app/services): full service
  catalog with tiers (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) and feature
  comparison.
- [Products](https://afro-tech-et.vercel.app/products): AFRO Suite — our
  ready-to-use business management systems (pharmacy, store/retail,
  hospital/clinic, school) available as a hosted product with a free trial.

## Authenticated application

- https://afro-tech-et.vercel.app/app is the AFRO Suite workspace
  (point-of-sale, inventory, patients, students, expenses, payroll, reports).
  It requires an account; content behind /app is private per company and is
  not crawlable. Public sign-in: /app/login, registration: /app/register.
